items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: No. I only recorded with Jelly in Chicago.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Jelly Roll out here on the coast in California? No. Did you ever work with Jelly?
No. I only recorded with Jelly in Chicago.
Did you ever play any other dates with Jelly or just the records?

items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: He told me, not worry about my part, but I played what he wrote for me

ctx.x: Yeah. But you made a lot of records with him in Chicago. Yeah. But they weren't the well rehearsed jobs. You didn't rehearse those much either? No. Did he have any music at those record days?

Yeah, music. He told me, not worry about my part, but I played what he wrote for me and he, I know some of them, they don't sound like you, they forget to turn that over. Uh-huh. But you guys played what you see. So some of them. He told Simmy too, you know. Uh-huh. To go for himself. Yeah. Spot, you know. He told me no way about it. I can't write your music. Uh-huh. Were those silk shirts white colored or? Different colored. Most they colored, you know, striped. Bright colored? Yeah. Yeah. One rang the other day…

An even funnier one than that that she pulled. About a month ago, she pointed to Daddy, she says, Kid Ory. And then she pointed in where I was, I was in my bedroom at the time, she says, Kid Mommy. And she pointed her side and says, Kid me. Don't kid me. Kid did me.
